text: なかなか　やりての　ようだな　おて　あわせ　ねがおうか！

structure.jp: なかなか　やりての　ようだな
structure.en: you seem to be quite capable

structure.jp: おて　あわせ　ねがおうか！
structure.en: shall I ask you for a match!

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: のようだ after a thing says that is how it looks to the speaker. やりての ようだ = 'you seem to be a capable one'.

patterns.name: 〜ましょうか
patterns.explanation: The おう ending plus か is the casual form of ましょうか: 'shall I'. With お before the thing asked for, it is a formal, old-style way to request it. ねがおうか = 'shall I ask you for it'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end of a statement is a rough, male way of saying 'huh' or 'right'. ようだな = 'so it seems, huh'.
